description: Checks an IPv4 address against the public X4BNet list of commercial VPN provider address ranges (about 11,000 CIDR blocks, refreshed by the list's maintainer). Returns whether the address falls in a listed VPN range and which range. A miss does not prove a direct connection, and IPv6 is not covered. Choose this tool for: Checks an IPv4 address against the public X4BNet list. Close alternatives on this server: security_barracuda_reputation (Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against the Barracuda); security_blocklist_de (Checks an IPv4 address against the Blocklist.de 'all' list). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_vpn_proxy_detector
title: Checks an IPv4 address against the public X4BNet list
